# Yamini Enterprises

> Exclusive Dealers and Service Providers for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur. Established in 2009, Yamini Enterprises specializes in Hitachi HVAC products and services, primarily serving Jodhpur, with project operations extending across Rajasthan. We are committed to providing reliable air-conditioning solutions for a wide range of applications.

## Key facts
- Business: HVAC Equipment Supplier, Air Conditioning Systems Dealer & Service Provider
- Industry: Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
- Brand: Exclusive dealer and service provider, Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group
- Authorisation: Authorised Sale & Service Dealer: Hitachi Air Conditioners
- Certification: An ISO 9002 Certified Company
- Established: 2009, Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India
- Founder: Mr. Pradeep Sharma (retired Indian Air Force serviceman)
- Service area: Jodhpur, with projects across Rajasthan
- Customers: homeowners (single rooms to whole houses), offices and commercial buildings, hotels and resorts, hospitals, industrial facilities and institutions
- Address: 134, R.K. Nagar, Opp. B.R. Birla Public School, Jodhpur, Rajasthan 342008, India
- Phone: +91 94141 00877, +91 63757 75857
- Email: pksharmajodhpur@gmail.com
- GSTIN: 08BCRPS3912F1ZA

## Services
- Sales and supply of the complete Hitachi air-conditioning range
- Installation and commissioning
- Annual maintenance (AMC)
- Repairs and breakdown service for Hitachi units
- Central AC projects: VRF, ductable and chiller systems for hotels, hospitals, offices and industry across Rajasthan

## Product range (Hitachi)
- [Inverter Split ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=inverter-split-acs): 22 models. Energy-saving inverter splits for homes and offices. KASHIKOI, MERAI, SUGOI, ACE, LOGICOOL, TOUSHI and TAKESHI series.
- [Fixed Speed Split ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=fixed-speed-split-acs): 9 models. Dependable, budget-friendly cooling for every room. TAKESHI, ZUNOH and LOGICOOL series.
- [Window ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=window-acs): 11 models. Compact single-unit cooling that installs in a window. SUMMER, KAZE REIDAN, KAZE PLUS and KAZE PLUS ECO series.
- [Cassette & Concealed ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=light-commercial-air-conditioners): 14 models. Light commercial cooling for shops, clinics and offices. Cassette, concealed and Flexi split air conditioners.
- [Ductable ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=ductable-air-conditioners): 26 models. Ducted cooling for halls, showrooms and large floors. Toushi and Takumi ranges, 5.5 TR to 16.5 TR.
- [VRF Systems](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=vrf-systems): 21 models. Central air for buildings with many zones. Set Free outdoor units, indoor units and central controllers.
- [Chillers](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=hitachi-chillers): 3 models. Plant-scale cooling for hospitals, malls and industry. Air-cooled screw, water-cooled screw and centrifugal chillers.
- [Portable & Other ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=ac): 2 models. Plug-and-play and other cooling options. Portable air conditioners and more.
